question.text: Based on lattice energy and other considerations which one of the following alkali metal chlorides is expected to have the highest melting point.

solution.text: Although lattice energy of LiCl higher than NaCl but LiCl is covalent in nature and NaCl ionic there after , the melting point decreases as we move NaCl because the lattice energy decreases as a size of alkali metal atom increases (lattice energy ∝ to melting point of alkali metal halide)
